set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically. Found while building a canvas host on the 56506d2 interaction pieces.

Problem
Hollow marks (stroked, unfilled circles, rings, outlined diamonds) are hit only on their outline. Users clicking the centre of a hollow marker miss it, and a host cannot opt in to interior hits without faking a transparent fill (which changes rendering semantics).

Scope
A PickPolicy option that treats the interior of closed hollow shapes as part of the hit region, per mark or per scene, independent of fill.

Acceptance criteria
1. With the option on, a point at the centre of a hollow circle point or ring path hits that mark; with it off, behaviour is unchanged.
2. Stack order and nearest-mark ties are unchanged for overlapping hollow marks, with a documented rule.
3. Identical on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: [Intaglio] Pick policy for the interior of hollow marks
